name: omnisense/omnigame
description: Omnigame: a game's presence on the stores, read under any PHP host - its store record (texts, dates, studios, platforms, price, pictures, scores, identifiers on other stores), a search by title, a player's library and whether a player owns a game, behind contracts by capability. Read only: nothing is bought, granted or written. Providers are packages of their own (omnigame/steam, omnigame/gog, omnigame/itch, omnigame/igdb, omnigame/rawg); the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.omnigame/steam: Steam: the store's records and search (no key), a player's library and ownership (Web API key)
suggest.omnigame/gog: GOG: the catalogue's records and search (no key)
suggest.omnigame/itch: itch.io: a game page's record (no key), whether a player owns one of your games (API key)
suggest.omnigame/igdb: IGDB: the catalogue, with identifiers on the stores (Twitch client credentials)
suggest.omnigame/rawg: RAWG: the catalogue, with the stores selling a game (API key)
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omnigame into their host when a site needs it
